structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: (Effective July 1, 2027) Grounds for revocation or suspension
law.text: The Board may revoke or suspend the license of any speech-language pathologist assistant for any of the causes set forth in § 54.1-2623, insofar as the action is applicable to practicing as a speech-language pathologist assistant.
